title: SellMineralCommand
description: Intent to sell quantity_kg of one mineral from this session's actor's inventory to a market, with the ship the actor is flying docked there. The vocabulary is WHERE, WHAT and HOW MUCH - THE CLIENT CANNOT STATE A PRICE, A PROCEEDS AMOUNT, A BALANCE OR ITS POSITION: the server computes the price from the market's saturation and the data table, checks docking with its own f64 ship state, and checks the inventory itself (CLAUDE.md principle 1, spec p1-03 I-74). An injected price, proceeds, balance, position or actor field is rejected by the schema and by serde as MALFORMED_COMMAND, not ignored. quantity_kg is an intent the server verifies against the inventory (INSUFFICIENT_QUANTITY), never a credit to anything. State-changing: command_id is the durable idempotency key in the SAME world-scoped ledger as MINE_RESOURCE (ADR-0016 section 1) - a command_id already accepted as a MINE_RESOURCE is a DUPLICATE_COMMAND_ID here. Judgement order and reject reasons: spec p1-03 section 4.2. Responses: exactly one COMMAND_RESULT, then - only when accepted, in the same tick, in this order - SALE_RECEIPT, INVENTORY_STATE, WALLET_STATE (spec p1-03 section 5.1a).

market_id.description: Row of the MARKET data table to sell to. A well-formed id that names no market in the ship's star system is TARGET_UNKNOWN, not MALFORMED_COMMAND.

mineral_id.description: Mineral to sell. A well-formed id that the market has no listing for is TARGET_UNKNOWN.

quantity_kg.description: How much the actor wants to sell. Must not exceed what the server holds for the actor (INSUFFICIENT_QUANTITY). 0 is not an intent: rejected by the schema.
